reddit.title: Introducing Improved Water Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share some significant updates to our water mechanics in Provincia! With our latest changes, water depth now operates efficiently within the C++ cellular automata, ensuring that terrain modifications like raising lips or digging ditches are accurately reflected without causing frame freezes. This means a smoother gameplay experience as you shape your colony. For a deeper dive into these improvements, check out our devtalk here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/water-that-sees-dirt-edits?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=water-that-sees-dirt-edits
